name: straykeys-marketplace
description: Marketplace for straykeys, which finds config keys that a Go program silently ignores.

plugins.name: straykeys
plugins.description: Find YAML and JSON config keys your Go program ignores: typos, wrong case, keys at the wrong level, bare-number durations. Checks against the real struct, for yaml.v3, encoding/json, viper and koanf.
